name: open-walnut
description: Personal AI powered by Claude — task management, Claude Code sessions, memory system, and web UI

scripts.prepublishOnly: WALNUT_REQUIRE_BUN=1 npm run build && cd web && npx vite build && cd .. && node scripts/check-publish.mjs
scripts.start: npm run web:build && node dist/cli.js web --port 3456
scripts.build:plugins: npm run build -w @open-walnut/plugin-api && npm run build -w @open-walnut/plugin-cli
scripts.build: npm run build:plugins && bash scripts/build-daemon.sh && tsup && rm -rf dist/data && cp -r src/data dist/ && for d in src/integrations/*/manifest.json; do cp "$d" "dist/integrations/$(basename $(dirname $d))/"; done && node scripts/ship-builtin-plugins.mjs
scripts.test:plugin-packages: npm run build:plugins && vitest run --config vitest.focus.config.ts tests/core/plugin-package-metadata.test.ts tests/core/plugin-cli-dev.test.ts tests/core/plugin-cli-scaffold.test.ts tests/core/plugin-publish-check.test.ts && node scripts/check-plugin-packages.mjs
scripts.test:quick: npm run docs:check && vitest run --config vitest.quick.config.ts
scripts.test:full: npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:live:daemon && npm run test:live:cloud
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run lint:paths && npm run test && npx playwright test
scripts.lint:plugins: npm run build:plugins && tsc --noEmit -p packages/plugin-api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/plugin-cli/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/typechecks/tsconfig.plugin-api.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/plugins/walnut-demo/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/plugins/walnut-time/tsconfig.json
scripts.web:build: bash scripts/build-daemon.sh && tsup && rm -rf dist/data && cp -r src/data dist/ && for d in src/integrations/*/manifest.json; do cp "$d" "dist/integrations/$(basename $(dirname $d))/"; done && node scripts/ship-builtin-plugins.mjs && cd web && npx vite build
scripts.dev:ephemeral: npm run web:build && node dist/cli.js web --ephemeral
scripts.dev:demo: npm run web:build && (lsof -ti:3457 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -15 2>/dev/null || true); (cat /tmp/open-walnut-demo/daemon.pid 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -15 2>/dev/null || true); sleep 1; echo "Demo server: http://localhost:3457  (data: $HOME/.open-walnut-demo, daemon: /tmp/open-walnut-demo — fully isolated from prod)"; OPEN_WALNUT_HOME="$HOME/.open-walnut-demo" WALNUT_DAEMON_DIR=/tmp/open-walnut-demo node dist/cli.js web --port 3457
